title: feat(ai): add metadata management tools as first-class Tool metadata files
body:
Adds 6 metadata CRUD tools to `@objectstack/service-ai`, each defined as an individual `.tool.ts` metadata file using `defineTool()` from `@objectstack/spec/ai`. Runtime handlers are co-located in `metadata-tools.ts` and bound at `ai:ready` time. No changes to `@objectstack/spec`.

### Tool Metadata Files (`service-ai/src/tools/*.tool.ts`)

Each tool is a first-class `Tool` metadata definition (validated by Zod at creation time) with `name`, `label`, `description`, `category`, `builtIn`, and `parameters`:

| File | Tool Name | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `create-object.tool.ts` | `create_object` | Validates snake_case name (object + per-field), checks for duplicates, registers object definition |
| `add-field.tool.ts` | `add_field` | Validates snake_case objectName/fieldName/reference/option values, verifies object exists, field doesn't exist, merges new field into definition |
| `modify-field.tool.ts` | `modify_field` | Validates snake_case objectName/fieldName, verifies object/field exist, applies partial patch to field properties |
| `delete-field.tool.ts` | `delete_field` | Validates snake_case objectName/fieldName, verifies object/field exist, removes field from definition |
| `list-metadata-objects.tool.ts` | `list_metadata_objects` | Returns object summaries with optional name/label filter and field inclusion (unique name avoids collision with data-tools `list_objects`) |
| `describe-metadata-object.tool.ts` | `describe_metadata_object` | Returns full schema with field array and feature flags (unique name avoids collision with data-tools `describe_object`) |

Tool names are intentionally prefixed with `metadata_` for `list` and `describe` operations to avoid collisions when both `registerDataTools` and `registerMetadataTools` are registered on the same `ToolRegistry`.

The `reference` parameter in `add_field` is a plain `string` (target object name, e.g. `'account'`), matching the canonical Field schema in `@objectstack/spec`.

### Architecture

- **Tool definitions** live in individual `.tool.ts` files following the repo's `.object.ts` / `.view.ts` metadata file convention
- **Handler factories** remain in `metadata-tools.ts`, which imports from the individual files and provides `registerMetadataTools()`
- Each tool is importable independently (e.g. `import { createObjectTool } from '@objectstack/service-ai'`)
- All tools are aggregated in `METADATA_TOOL_DEFINITIONS` array for bulk access

Registration follows the same pattern as `registerDataTools`:

```ts
import { registerMetadataTools } from '@objectstack/service-ai';

ctx.hook('ai:ready', async (aiService) => {
  const metadataService = ctx.getService<IMetadataService>('metadata');
  registerMetadataTools(aiService.toolRegistry, { metadataService });
});
```

### Tests

79 unit tests in `service-ai/src/__tests__/metadata-tools.test.ts` covering:
- Individual tool metadata properties (label, category, builtIn, parameters schema)
- Handler execution and input validation (snake_case for object names, field names, references, and select option values)
- Error handling (non-existent objects/fields, duplicates, invalid names, duplicate initial fields)
- Dual registration with data tools (no name collisions)
- Full create→add→modify→delete→describe lifecycle test
